title: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English
abstract: arXiv:2610.18343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training quantisation reduces the memory cost of large language models, but it remains unclear whether compression preserves language skills of regional varieties as reliably as their standard-language counterparts. We study this question for Bavarian, Standard German, and English using BAVGROUND, a multiple-choice benchmark, where 206 source questions are aligned across all three languages. Across 14 open-weight 7B--10B instruction models, we compare BF16 with 8-bit GPTQ and two 4-bit settings, GPTQ and AWQ. Eight-bit GPTQ remains close to BF16 and largely preserves the relative behaviour of the three languages, while 4-bit quantisation was found to be much less stable. The two 4-bit methods reduce average accuracy by about 1.4--1.5 percentage points and change 11.9--16.0% of BF16 decisions, with changes concentrated on examples where the BF16 model is already uncertain. This instability does not translate into a consistent Bavar

translated_title: 轻量化但语言上公平吗？巴伐利亚语、德语与英语的量化鲁棒性研究
translated_abstract: 训练后量化可以降低大语言模型的内存开销，但压缩是否能像对待标准语言那样可靠地保留区域性语言变体的语言能力，目前仍不清楚。我们利用多项选择基准BAVGROUND，针对巴伐利亚语、标准德语和英语研究这一问题，其中206个源问题在三种语言间均已对齐。在14个开源权重的7B–10B指令模型上，我们将BF16与8位GPTQ以及两种4位设置（GPTQ和AWQ）进行比较。结果表明，8位GPTQ与BF16表现接近，并在很大程度上保留了三种语言的相对行为，而4位量化的稳定性则差得多。两种4位方法使平均准确率下降约1.4–1.5个百分点，并改变了11.9–16.0%的BF16决策，且这些变化集中在BF16模型本已不确定的示例上。这种不稳定性并未转化为一致的巴伐利亚语……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究利用三种语言对齐的BAVGROUND基准发现，8位GPTQ量化基本能保留模型在巴伐利亚语、标准德语和英语上的相对表现，而4位量化（GPTQ和AWQ）稳定性明显更差，其引发的决策变化主要集中在模型本已不确定的示例上。
